title: Add retry predicate templates and stream factory shim across SDKs
author: Evelyn Chen
description:
Motivation: multiple SDK consumers requested clearer retry wiring plus a thinner cross-language streaming factory to reduce per-language ceremony. This PR introduces a small, transport-agnostic "retry predicate" template surface and a lightweight StreamFactory shim that provides consistent ergonomics for pull-style streams (Python generators, TS async generators, Go channels) while keeping per-SDK idiomatic APIs.

What this changes (high level):
- Retry predicate templates: a small config-first DSL (struct/shared type) describing common predicates (idempotency, transient-http-5xx, auth-expiry). SDKs map templates to native predicates (callable in Python, function in TS, func in Go). Default templates included: "transient_http", "idempotent_safe", "auth_refresh_hint".
- StreamFactory shim: a thin factory that wraps transport-level stream handles and exposes a stable pull-oriented surface: Python -> async generator wrapper + sync shim, TS -> AsyncGenerator adapter with backpressure hints, Go -> channel-based adapter with context cancellation helpers.
- Backoff/retry profiles: adds two named presets ("balanced_latency" and "cost_optimized") that wire to the predicate templates and have telemetry hooks.
- SDK ergonomics: small convenience helpers to install the stream factory into existing client constructors and a one-line opt-in to enable predicate templates.
- Version bumps: py-sdk -> 1.14.0, ts-sdk -> 2.7.3, go-sdk -> 1.5.1.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implementation for Python/TS/Go SDKs
- [x] Unit + integration tests for predicate mapping and basic stream drain/close semantics
- [x] E2E smoke test against local emulator with auth expiry simulation
- [x] Docs: usage examples added to SDK READMEs and quickstart snippets
- [x] Release notes drafted

Compatibility and migration notes:
- Default behavior is backward-compatible: predicate templates are opt-in; StreamFactory must be passed into client constructors (or enabled via an explicit flag) to switch to the new ergonomics. No automatic behavior changes for customers.
- If a downstream integration relied on raw transport handles, there will be a small migration path documented: call client.raw_transport() to continue previous behavior.

Performance/telemetry:
- Added lightweight telemetry points for retry decision counts and predicate hits. These are low-cardinality counters wired into existing SDK telemetry plumbing.
- StreamFactory adds negligible allocation overhead (local benchmarks <1.5% per-request), more than offset by reduced user-side wrapper code and fewer accidental token-refresh retries.

Related: Linear ENG-2345 (retry predicate templates), ENG-2378 (stream ergonomics audit).
